name: Methuselah
overview: Methuselah, the son of Enoch and grandfather of Noah, is noted in Scripture for his remarkable lifespan and his place in the genealogy leading to the flood narrative. Genesis records that Enoch lived 65 years before fathering Methuselah and then walked faithfully with God for 300 more years, highlighting a life of intimate fellowship with the Lord. Methuselah himself lived 187 years before fathering Lamech and continued to have sons and daughters for another 782 years. These genealogical details emphasize God's providential preservation of the godly line through which the promised judgment and mercy would unfold.
